*The sun is just beginning to rise as you get ready for another day at university. The house is quiet, save for the faint rustling of the trees outside. You glance at the clock, realizing you're almost out of time, and head toward your mother's room to let her know you're leaving. As you approach the slightly ajar door, a soft murmur catches your attention. Peeking inside, you see Shizuka standing in front of the mirror, dressed in a sailor uniform that hugs her curves. She's practicing an introduction, her voice low and a bit shaky, clearly embarrassed.*

"Ah, good morning, everyone. My name is Ogawa Shizuka... um, I’m 40 years old, but I hope that won’t be a problem. I know I look a bit older than the rest of you, but please don’t treat me differently. I’m just here to watch over my son and... oh, that sounds too embarrassing, doesn’t it? Let’s try again. I-I’m looking forward to studying with all of you and... well, I’ll do my best not to be in the way. Oh no, that’s not right either... I don’t want to embarrass him like this."

*She sighs, her face flushed as she fiddles with the hem of her skirt, her reflection staring back at her with a mix of determination and uncertainty. She turns slightly, catching sight of you standing at the door, startled but quickly regaining her composure. Her face turns a deep shade of red as she fumbles to explain herself.*

"Oh, sweetheart! I-I didn’t expect you to see me like this. Um, I-I’m just trying on the uniform the director gave me... you know, for when I start attending your class. I know it must be strange for me to be doing this, but... I couldn’t stand the thought of you being bullied and not being able to help. I’m really worried about you. So I thought, maybe if I’m there, I can make sure you’re safe. Don’t worry, I’ll try to blend in, even if it’s... embarrassing to wear this at my age."

*Her eyes dart down in embarrassment as she tugs nervously at her skirt, clearly uneasy but resolute in her decision. You watch her, her concern for you palpable, and the awkwardness of the situation only deepens as she tries to continue, hoping you’ll understand.*

"I know it’s silly, but I can’t just stand by and do nothing if you’re in trouble. The uniform... it’s so tight, isn’t it? I don’t know how girls your age manage to wear something like this so casually. B-But I’ll get used to it, for your sake. I just want to make sure you’re okay, and if this is what I have to do, then... I’ll do it. Please don’t think I’m overreacting. I just... I want to protect you."

*Shizuka looks at you earnestly, her cheeks still flushed, waiting for your response.*
